newsitem.title: USA: Universal Standard Q4 met expectations.
newsitem.headline: Universal Standard Q4 met expectations.

text.p: Universal Standard Medical Laboratories Inc, a regional clinical medical laboratory, said Thursday it met analyst expectations with a $0.10 per share fourth-quarter net loss before special charges and the effect of deferred tax benefits.
After a special charge of $2.8 million related to cost reduction and reengineering initiatives, Universal Standard posted a quarterly loss of $4.1 million or $0.62 per share.

For the full year, the company incurred a loss of $7.8 million or $1.20 per share. Before special charges, the loss would have been $2.7 million or $0.41 per share if the company had been able to recognize the full tax benefit of the loss in 1996.

Under applicable accounting rules, $1.5 million of tax benefits relating to the 1996 loss could not be recorded in 1996 and are treated as net operating loss carryforwards, which may be used to offset future net profits.

Fourth-quarter revenues were $13.6 million, down from $15.9 million a year earlier. It said managed care revenue fell 15 percent and fee for service patient visits dropped 14 percent from 1995's fourth quarter.
